abstract.p: Background: Targeted inhibition of BRAF may improve outcomes for patients with advanced melanoma. We assessed dabrafenib in routine clinical practice. Methods: We reviewed 193 adults treated at 5 centers between 2022 and 2025. The primary endpoint was objective response, with survival and toxicity as secondary endpoints. Results: Objective response occurred in 53% of patients after a median follow-up of 21 months. Grade 3 toxicity occurred in 9% of patients. Conclusions: BRAF-directed treatment showed meaningful activity with manageable toxicity. Prospective validation is warranted.
